item.title: Iran condemns Netanyahu’s presence in UAE
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Ministry has condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s visit to the United Arab Emirates, warning regional countries of what it called the “very dangerous consequences” of Israel’s presence in the region.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Ministry has condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s visit to the United Arab Emirates, warning regional countries of what it called the “very dangerous consequences” of Israel’s presence in the region.

item.title: Pezeshkian: US and Israeli regime plan to create and exacerbate internal divisions in Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing the necessity of maintaining unity, solidarity, and national cohesion, President Masoud Pezeshkian said that enemies of Iran have realized they cannot subdue the people through war or military action and are instead attempting to harm the country by fomenting and exacerbating internal divisions; therefore, public participation and the cooperation of all segments of society and various groups constitute the most vital support for overcoming threats and resolving the issues.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86278778/Pezeshkian-US-and-Israeli-regime-plan-to-create-and-exacerbate

Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing the necessity of maintaining unity, solidarity, and national cohesion, President Masoud Pezeshkian said that enemies of Iran have realized they cannot subdue the people through war or military action and are instead attempting to harm the country by fomenting and exacerbating internal divisions; therefore, public participation and the cooperation of all segments of society and various groups constitute the most vital support for overcoming threats and resolving the issues.

item.title: IRGC: New weapons will be deployed if nature of conflict changes
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC), says IRGC is continuously developing and mass-producing new weapons to strengthen its defensive capabilities, IRGC spokesman Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi said, adding that Iran would deploy new weapons if the nature of any future conflict changed.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86278745/IRGC-New-weapons-will-be-deployed-if-nature-of-conflict-changes

item.title: Top security official: Trump caught in quagmire, unable to decide
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) Mohsen Rezaei says Iran has conveyed its conditions to the United States, but US President Donald Trump is unable to make a decision.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86278733/Top-security-official-Trump-caught-in-quagmire-unable-to-decide

item.title: Iran’s airspace safe for all foreign, international flights: CEO of IAC
